name: Peek
description: Peek Stash Browser is a modern web application for browsing and streaming your Stash media library. Features: - Modern React frontend with responsive design - Video streaming proxied through Stash (no local media access needed) - Adaptive quality selection (Direct, 1080p, 720p, 480p, 360p) - JWT-based authentication with admin/user roles - Advanced filtering and search - Subtitle/caption support - 4-step setup wizard for easy first-time configuration This is a single-container solution that includes: - Frontend web interface (React + Vite) - Backend API server (Node.js/Express + TypeScript) - SQLite database for user data First-Time Setup: After installation, access http:// :6969 and complete the 4-step setup wizard: 1. Welcome screen 2. Create admin account (username + password) 3. Connect to Stash (URL + API key) 4. Setup complete! Requirements: - Existing Stash server with GraphQL API enabled - Network access from Peek to Stash server - At least 1GB RAM recommended Upgrading from v1.x: Your existing STASH_URL and STASH_API_KEY will auto-migrate to the database on first start. After successful migration, you can remove these env vars from your container config.

paths.name: App Data Directory
paths.description: Peek configuration and database. Requires read/write access.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Web interface port - access Peek at http:// :6969

variables.name: JWT Secret Key
variables.description: Optional. Leave empty and Peek generates a secret in /app/data/.jwt-secret on first start. Set it only to control the value (openssl rand -hex 32).

variables.name: Stash GraphQL URL (Legacy)
variables.description: MIGRATION ONLY: Leave blank for new installs - configured via Setup Wizard. Existing v1.x installs: keep your value, it will auto-migrate to database on first start.

variables.name: Stash API Key (Legacy)
variables.description: MIGRATION ONLY: Leave blank for new installs - configured via Setup Wizard. Existing v1.x installs: keep your value, it will auto-migrate to database on first start.

variables.name: Node Environment
variables.description: Node.js environment mode. Leave as 'production' for normal use.

variables.name: Secure Cookies
variables.description: Enable secure cookies (HTTPS only). Set to 'true' only if you use HTTPS with a reverse proxy.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID that owns the App Data Directory (99 = nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID that owns the App Data Directory (100 = users).

variables.name: Reverse proxies in front of Peek
variables.description: Number of reverse proxies (SWAG, Nginx Proxy Manager, Traefik) between browsers and Peek. Leave empty if none. Too high lets anyone fake their address.

variables.name: Proxy auth trusted addresses
variables.description: Only with PROXY_AUTH_HEADER: comma-separated IPs or CIDR ranges of your auth proxy as Peek sees it. The username header is honoured only from these; the log names the address to add. Leave empty if you do not use proxy authentication.
